title: Flood Warning
description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida... St Johns River Near Above Lake Harney affecting Seminole County. .Heavy rainfall has caused river levels on the St. Johns Above Lake Harney near Geneva to rise into Major Flood Stage. Continued rises through Major Flood Stage are forecast through early next week. For the St. Johns River...including Cocoa 9w, Above Lake Harney, Sanford, Deland, Astor...Major flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast. The forecast river level is above the all time flood of record. * WHERE...St Johns River near Above Lake Harney. * WHEN...Until further notice. * IMPACTS...At 10.8 feet, Water covers State Road 46 and it may become impassable near Jungle Road and Prevatt Road. title: Flood Warning
description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida... title: Flood Warning
description: ...The National Weather Service in Jacksonville has issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in Florida... North Fork Black Creek At Middleburg affecting Clay County. Additional information is available at https://water.weather.gov/wfo/JAX The next statement will be issued Saturday afternoon at 230 PM EST. * WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast. * WHERE...North Fork Black Creek at Middleburg. * WHEN...From Saturday afternoon to Sunday morning. * IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, Water begins to flood wooded areas along portions of North Fork Black Creek downstream from the gage to near Blanding Blvd. At 15.0 feet, Water begins to enter backyards of residential properties along Hawk Haven Road and Lazy Acres Road and Redbug Alley on the north bank of the North Fork. Flooding begins at Enchanted Lane on the south bank of the North Fork. At 16.0 feet, Flooding expands into the yards of more properties along Lazy Acres Road on the north bank of the North Fork. Flooding begins further downstream of the Blanding Blvd Bridge along North and South Lee. Flooding begins on areas of the south bank of the North Fork, particularly at Scenic Drive and Enchanted Lane. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 1:00 PM EST Friday the stage was 3.0 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early tomorrow afternoon to a crest of 15.3 feet tomorrow evening. It will then fall below flood stage early Sunday morning. - Flood stage is 15.0 feet. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
